_comment: Drawer account configuration. Fill in your actual values. routing_number is validated with mod-10 at startup. See buildspec.md §6 for face layout requirements.
_comment_acct: Replace 000000000 with your real account number. Right-justified in the On-Us field; no zero-fill for unused positions.
_comment_rt: Replace with your 9-digit ABA routing number. Validated with mod-10 check digit on startup.
_comment_frac: Format: prefix-suffix/FRB. Displayed upper-right on the check face. Example: 70-2322/719
